title: Does local learning preserve plasticity? Forward-Forward versus backpropagation in continual learning — code and results
description: Code, Colab notebooks and per-task results for the manuscript 'Does local learning preserve plasticity? Forward-Forward versus backpropagation in continual learning' (submitted to Neural Networks). Includes the experiment library (PyTorch), five notebooks, per-task metrics of every run (JSON Lines), configuration files, and a script that rebuilds every table and figure of the paper without a GPU. Code: MIT licence; results, tables and figures: CC BY 4.0.
